N05 ADD-AC [medium]: D1/D5 DrivePrecondition_PreservesApprovedContextAndRejectsMalformedCounts. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:56.
Evidence: drive-resources.c set_drive_type detaches images and sets unit type/bus state; drive_disable changes enabled/port state. iecbus.c lines 493-547 makes bus routing depend on resource state. With TDE off, drive-type bit alone does not select true-drive routing, but resource changes still occur. A TDE-on module with has_drives=0 also bypasses per-drive initialization.
Assessment: The approved precondition has effects beyond bypassing a copy. Its permitted workload/context and invalid DRIVE payload behavior should have explicit observable outcomes rather than an assumed universal equivalence.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D1 rejects truncated/invalid has_tde/has_drives payloads before launch and proves required NONE flags cannot be overridden. D5 records effective resources/media and demonstrates the approved workload continuation and media context under the precondition on both hosts, or reports a blocker requiring an explicit requirement disposition.

N06 ADD-AC [medium]: D0/D2 ShimInventory_TraversesHelperOnlyUseAndRetainsManagedMocks. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:49.
Evidence: R6 explicitly requires transitive enumeration but its named controls cover a direct plain Fact and a string-only mention. Actual tests use helpers/providers and IViceNative also represents an interface usable by managed fakes.
Assessment: A helper-only positive control and pure-managed fake negative control make the authorized denominator mechanically distinguishable.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D0 mocks must find a test whose only path is test to helper/provider to shim, and retain a managed fake IViceNative case with no native load. D2 proves the same method-ID selection and both-library zero-load evidence without broad file/class exclusion.

N07 ADD-AC [medium]: D1/D5 ResumeBudget_CoversRequiredPostLoadInterval. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:84.
Evidence: The supplied legacy clock is 109163946; -autostart first performs a reboot/delay. The proposed command leaves -limitcycles <n> unspecified. maincpu_clk_limit is compared to absolute maincpu_clk, while the observer requires gate acknowledgments throughout the prelude and resumed interval.
Assessment: A short absolute limit can stop before the deferred load or immediately after a large restored clock. A passing short prefix must not stand in for the required complete post-resume comparison interval.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D1 defines the exact cycle budget/window and input acknowledgment protocol. D5 retains a nonempty expected post-load interval and rejects prelude-only exit, early termination, missing/extra/reordered half-cycles and a truncated round-trip baseline on both hosts; include restored clocks above the initial launch budget.
